title: Relative Mayer–Vietoris gluing for the single-complex base-change map
statement: Let X' \xrightarrow{g'} X and S' \xrightarrow{g} S be a cartesian square with f:X\to S quasi-compact and quasi-separated and f':X'\to S' its base change [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Let K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) and let L(g')^*K\to K' be a map in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X'}) [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose X=U\cup V, where U and V are quasi-compact open subschemes and U\cap V is quasi-compact. For each W\in\{U,V,U\cap V\}, let W'=X'\times_X W and assume that the canonical composite Lg^*Rf_{W,*}(K|_W)\to Rf'_{W',*}L(g'|_{W'})^*(K|_W)\to Rf'_{W',*}(K'|_{W'}) is an isomorphism, using derived pullback and direct image [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then the canonical composite Lg^*Rf_*K\to Rf'_*L(g')^*K\to Rf'_*K' is an isomorphism.
